$Comment: Inkwell_Role_Chicken_Annoying — a chicken with mood swings. A built-in 'Type: Random' instruction with ExecuteFor [5,12] acts as a timer that randomly commits the chicken to ORBIT (circle the nearest player — the annoying mode — via the custom Inkwell_Orbit BodyMotion) or WANDER for a random 5-12s window, then re-rolls (~50/50). On an ORBIT->WANDER transition it PECKS ONCE before settling down: the orbit branch raises a per-NPC 'WasOrbiting' flag while it's actively orbiting, and the wander branch consumes that flag on the tick it takes over to fire a single blocking melee Attack (vanilla Root_NPC_Attack_Melee chain; light damage via the InteractionVars Melee_Damage override) before clearing the flag and wandering. Exactly one peck per orbit->wander switch — the blocking action list runs once and clears the flag, so it can't repeat. Built from built-in instruction primitives only (Type:Random, Flag sensor / SetFlag, Attack) plus the custom Inkwell_Orbit. A self-contained 'Generic' role (NOT a Variant): a Variant's Modify block runs values through the expression system and rejects a structural Instructions array, so behavior lives at the role's top level. Reuses the vanilla Chicken appearance (referenced vanilla id, no Inkwell_ prefix). Inkwell_Orbit is registered by InkwellPlugin.setup().

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the annoying chicken

Instructions.$Comment: The mode timer. A Type:Random node with ExecuteFor [5,12] picks ORBIT or WANDER, commits to it for a random 5-12s window, then re-rolls — this IS the 'timer that randomly decides orbit vs wander'. The orbit->wander transition is caught with the per-NPC 'WasOrbiting' flag (see the two branches). Equal weights ~= 50/50.

ORBIT branch. Top-level Sensor is Any so a picked window always runs (a bare Player sensor would idle the whole window if no player were in range). Orbit a sensed player and raise WasOrbiting; with no player, just wander and DON'T raise the flag — so ending a player-less 'orbit' window won't fire a peck.

WANDER branch. If we arrived straight from orbiting (WasOrbiting set) with a player in reach, do ONE blocking peck and clear the flag — the orbit->wander attack. Otherwise clear the flag (so a player wandering into range mid-window can't trigger a stray peck) and just wander.

The orbit->wander peck. Gated on WasOrbiting AND a player in range. Seek (StopDistance 1.8) turns the body to face the player (while orbiting it faced its tangential heading, so the forward melee selector would otherwise miss) and a 0.35s windup with an 'Eat' head-jab; then one Attack, then clear WasOrbiting so this can't repeat. ActionsBlocking + not a Continue node, so while pecking it owns the tick and the clear/wander steps below don't run.
Not pecking (flag clear, or no player to peck): make sure the flag is clear so the transition can't fire later this window, then fall through to wander.
